table.retrieve:
select  	invcode=SL.saleinvcode, 
			type= 'Sale',
			AccName = A.Name,
			itemname=I.name, 
			remarks=SL.remarks,
			ref=SL.custrefno,
			stockatsale = CASE ( (SD.godownbalancestock / SD.PackUnits) - CAST(SD.godownbalancestock / SD.PackUnits AS INT ) ) When 0 Then (SD.godownbalancestock / SD.PackUnits) Else SD.godownbalancestock End ,
			balanceloosepack = CASE ( (SD.godownbalancestock / SD.PackUnits) - CAST(SD.godownbalancestock / SD.PackUnits AS INT ) ) When 0 Then ' ' Else 'L' End ,
  			qty= CASE ( ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits) - CAST( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits ) ELSE (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) END,
  			loosepack= CASE ( ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits) - CAST( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ' ' ELSE 'L' END,
			date=SL.date,
			batch=SD.batch,
			expiry=SD.expiry,
			username=U.username,
			manufacturer=M.name,
			ItemCategory = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemCategory IC WHERE IC.ICatCode = I.ICatCode),
			utn = SD.saleutn

From 	saleledger SL,
		saledetail  SD,
		Users U,
		Item I,
		Manufacturer M,
		Accounts A

Where (SL.date>=:ar_stdate) and
		(SL.date<=:ar_enddate) and
		(SL.salesmancode=U.usercode)and
		(SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode)  and
		(SL.custcode = A.AccCode ) And
		(I.icode=SD.icode)and
		(I.antinorcotix='Y')and
		(I.manfcode=M.manfcode)

Union All 

select  	invcode=SL.srinvcode,
			type= 'S/R',
			AccName = A.Name,
			itemname=I.name,
			remarks=SL.remarks,
			ref=SL.custrefno,
			stockatsale= null ,
			balanceloosepack=' ',
  			qty= CASE ( ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits) - CAST( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits ) ELSE (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) END,
  			loosepack= CASE ( ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits) - CAST( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) / SD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ' ' ELSE 'L' END,
			date=SL.date,
			batch=SD.batch,
			expiry=SD.expiry,
			username=U.username,
			manufacturer=M.name,
			ItemCategory = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemCategory IC WHERE IC.ICatCode = I.ICatCode),
			utn = SD.srutn

From 	SRledger SL,
		SRDetail  SD,
		Users U,
		Item I,
		Manufacturer M,
		Accounts A

Where (SL.date>=:ar_stdate) and
		(SL.date<=:ar_enddate) and
		(SL.salesmancode=U.usercode)and
		(SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode)  and
		(SL.custcode = A.AccCode ) And
		(I.icode=SD.icode)and
		(I.antinorcotix='Y')and
		(I.manfcode=M.manfcode)		

union all

select  	invcode=PL.purinvcode,
			type= 'Pur',
			AccName = A.Name,
			itemname=I.name,
			remarks=PL.remarks,
			ref=' ',
			stockatpur = CASE ( ( (PD.currstock + ((PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty + PD.BonusQty) * CASE When PL.purcatcode in (1,2) Then PD.PackUnits ELSE 1 END)) / PD.PackUnits) - CAST(  (PD.currstock+ ((PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty + PD.BonusQty) * CASE When PL.purcatcode in (1,2) Then PD.PackUnits ELSE 1 END)) / PD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 Then ( (PD.currstock + ((PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty + PD.BonusQty) * CASE When PL.purcatcode in (1,2) Then PD.PackUnits ELSE 1 END)) / PD.PackUnits) Else (PD.currstock + ((PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty + PD.BonusQty) * CASE When PL.purcatcode in (1,2) Then PD.PackUnits ELSE 1 END) ) End ,
			balanceloosepack = CASE ( (PD.currstock / PD.PackUnits) - CAST( PD.currstock / PD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 Then ' ' Else 'L' End ,
			qty = Case When PL.purcatcode in (1,2) Then 
								(PD.PackQty + PD.BonusQty)
							Else
				 				CASE ( ( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits) - CAST( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits AS INT) ) WHEN 0 THEN ((PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits ) ELSE (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) END
							End,
			loosepack = Case When PL.purcatcode in (1,2) Then 
								' '
							Else
				 				CASE ( ( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits) - CAST( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ' ' ELSE 'L' END
							End,
			date=PL.date,
			batch=PD.batch,
			expiry=PD.expiry,
			username=U.username,
			Manufacturer=M.name,
			ItemCategory = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemCategory IC WHERE IC.ICatCode = I.ICatCode),
			utn = PD.purutn

from 	purledger PL,
		purdetail  PD,
		Users U,
		Item I,
		Manufacturer M,
		Accounts A

where (PL.date>=:ar_stdate) and
		(PL.date<=:ar_enddate) and 
		(PL.posted='Y')and
		(PL.salesmancode=U.usercode)and
		(PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode) and
		(PL.Suppcode = A.AccCode ) And
		(I.icode=PD.icode) and
		(I.antinorcotix='Y')and
		(I.manfcode=M.manfcode)

Union All

select  	invcode=PL.prinvcode,
			type= 'P/R',
			AccName = A.Name,
			itemname=I.name,
			remarks=PL.remarks,
			ref=' ',
			stockatpr= null,
			balanceloosepack = '',
   		qty= CASE ( ( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits) - CAST( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ((PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits ) ELSE (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) END,
   		loosepack= CASE ( ( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits) - CAST( (PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) / PD.PackUnits AS INT) ) When 0 THEN ' ' ELSE 'L' END,
			date=PL.date,
			batch=PD.batch,
			expiry=PD.expiry,
			username=U.username,
			Manufacturer=M.name,
			ItemCategory = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemCategory IC WHERE IC.ICatCode = I.ICatCode),
			utn = PD.prutn
from  prledger PL,
		prdetail  PD,
		Users U,
		Item I,
		Manufacturer M,
		Accounts A
where (PL.date>=:ar_stdate) and
		(PL.date<=:ar_enddate) and
		(PL.posted='Y')and
		(PL.salesmancode=U.usercode)and
		(PL.prinvcode=PD.prinvcode) and
		(PL.Suppcode = A.AccCode ) And
		(I.icode=PD.icode) and
		(I.antinorcotix='Y')and
		(I.manfcode=M.manfcode)
Order by itemname, utn
